post.description:
The token is issued and signed by the account library, with a cap per network and per hour, so that the free allowance does not become infinite. It is shown only once and cannot be recovered: sign in to the account and bring the lists to it (`POST /api/auth/claim`, which the account page does by itself at sign-in) so that you do not depend on it. The `webhook_segredo` can be read again at `GET /api/dono`. Every webhook POST has `webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp` (Unix seconds) and `webhook-signature: v1,<base64>`: HMAC-SHA256 of `id.timestamp.corpo` with the key of your `whsec_…` (the base64 after the prefix). It is the Standard Webhooks pattern: any library of it checks it; reject a timestamp outside 5 minutes. After `POST /api/dono/segredo`, the previous one still signs for 24 h (two `v1,` parts in the header).

get.description:
Each service shows what it delivers (`inclui`), its limit (`aviso`), the price in cents of reais, the Pix copy-and-paste code for the price and the order address. `pagamento` tells how to pay: `liberacao: automatica` (Pix, card or boleto through the gateway; once paid, the order continues by itself) or `manual` (Pix to the key, with the receipt checked by hand). The answer comes by e-mail. `lingua=pt|en` selects the language of the text (default: the language of the request).

pagamento.description: Automatic: `metodo: asaas`, `liberacao: automatica`, `formas` (`pix`, `cartao_boleto`) and `precisa_documento` (the payer's CPF or CNPJ, only on the first purchase of the account). Manual: `metodo: pix`, the `chave`, `liberacao: manual` and the accepted `comprovante`.

post.summary: Orders a service: in JSON, the charge that releases by itself (`liberacao: automatica`); in multipart, the Pix with a receipt.
post.description:
Automatic (JSON): `email` and, when `precisa_documento`, `documento` and `nome` of the payer; `forma` `pix` (the default) or `cartao_boleto`. The answer (201) is the charge: `id`, `estado: pendente`, `servico`, `centavos`, the `pix` (`copia_e_cola`, `imagem`) or `pagamento_em` (the card and boleto page) and `estado_em` (`GET /api/credito/asaas/:id`, which becomes `pago`). Once paid, the order goes by itself to the person who serves it. Manual (multipart): make the Pix of the price to the key of `GET /api/servicos` and send the receipt. In both, `nome`, `telefone`, `empresa` (company or CNPJ), `mensagem` (what you need, up to 2,000 characters), `contexto` (where the order came from, up to 300), `pagina` (the open page, up to 2,000) and `navegador_id` (browser UUID) go together. The order is recorded with everything that arrived, the receipt included, with the signed-in account, the network and the browser of the requester, and goes to the e-mail of the person who serves it, who checks the Pix and answers at the given e-mail.
Returns: { id, estado, servico, valor, aviso }

The payment releases by itself what was bought: the package becomes the `cred_…` token that already comes in the answer; the balance goes to the organization of the signed-in account. The first purchase sends `documento` (CPF or CNPJ, which goes to the gateway and is not kept here) and `nome`; `email`, `pagina` and `navegador_id` are optional and are recorded. With `forma: "cartao_boleto"`, the charge is open: the answer has `pagamento_em`, the gateway page where you pay by card, boleto or Pix (due in three days). With `forma: "cartao"` and the `cartao` (`titular`, `numero`, `mes`, `ano`, `cvv`, `documento`, `email`, `cep`, `numero_endereco`, `telefone`), the charge is paid by card in the same request: 200 with `estado: "pago"`, 202 with `conferir` while the issuer reviews, 422 when the card is declined; the card is not kept. One message every 10 seconds per network: a message that arrives early waits its turn and goes out, with no error. The message reaches the team by e-mail, with the `email` as the reply address. For voice, send multipart/form-data: `dados` contains this JSON (up to 32 KiB) and `audio` contains a WebM, Ogg or M4A audio file (up to 2 MB). The audio can replace message. The browser records up to two minutes. The audio goes as an attachment to the owner's e-mail.

The interface reports by itself JS errors, rejected promises, scripts or CSS that did not load and CSP blocks (once per session), and the app reports handled failures through `window.mmErro.relata`. The server validates the envelope, redacts credentials, e-mail and phone, groups repetitions of the same failure per minute and records an operational event; nothing is written to a database. It does not keep the IP, cookies, query or the full User-Agent. It always answers 204, also for an invalid report.

A same-origin report with no body, sent automatically when a charge becomes visible. It does not start a payment, does not grant access and does not receive an identity or credential. It does not write to a database per report. It counts events, not unique people. The private operator dashboard separates API payment requests and interface openings per UTC day; the two numbers can overlap.

post.summary: Subscribes to and pays for the monthly offer by card through the API, when enabled.
post.description:
Requires active monthly sales, or staging enabled and a test payment that the server authorizes. Without this authorization, it answers 404. Requires a session authenticated in the last five minutes. It does not accept Authorization or X-Api-Key. Send only the declared fields, as JSON up to 4 KiB, over HTTPS. recurso is accepted only when the product requires it and the server confirms its ownership. simulado must match the catalog and the authorized environment of this request. If the ticket expires, the server refuses the switch to production before it creates the charge. The price and the benefits come from the server. The card goes to Asaas only in this request; it is not saved or returned. The buyer IP comes from the server, never from the body. Wait up to 120 seconds. Repeating the offer returns the existing reservation. An inconclusive result requires a lookup by the reference before another creation. The creation does not grant a benefit. The payment confirmed at Asaas grants the paid period.
